pdf_limited_structure.summary: PDF text: columns, tables and images may be misordered or missing.
pdf_limited_structure.description: PDF page text and directly placed embedded raster images. Vector drawings and images nested in Form objects are not read; columns and tables may be misordered. Images follow page text, not reading order, and may be fragments. Check the original before relying on the result.

pdf_text_layout.summary: PDF text: reading order and tables may be wrong; the page image shows the layout.
pdf_text_layout.description: Page visuals are retained. Extracted PDF text may have incorrect reading order or table relationships. A matching quotation validates the extracted words, not their visual arrangement. Check the retained page images for layout and context.

presentation_renderer_unavailable.summary: Slide not rendered: charts and drawn shapes may be missing.
presentation_renderer_unavailable.description: Slide rendering was unavailable. Extracted text, tables, notes and supported embedded pictures are retained, but charts, drawn shapes and their relationships may be missing. Check the original presentation.

presentation_render_failed.summary: Slide rendering failed: charts and drawn shapes may be missing.
presentation_render_failed.description: Slide rendering did not complete. Extracted text, tables, notes and supported embedded pictures are retained, but charts, drawn shapes and their relationships may be missing. Check the original presentation.

unsupported_document_visual.summary: A visual here was not captured and may hold information.
unsupported_document_visual.description: A visual object was detected but not captured for analysis. It may be decorative or contain information. Compare captured content with the original document to check what is missing.

document_image_unavailable.summary: An image here could not be read.
document_image_unavailable.description: An embedded image could not be decoded or converted. Its location is retained, but its visual content was not available for analysis. Check the original document.
